stereotypeDefinition.comment: The C# default value of this Service Proxy Parameter, as the code declares it, e.g. int page = 1. A Service Proxy Parameter has no Value of its own, and method signatures are fully managed, so an unmodelled default is removed from the code.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Default Value
stereotypeDefinition.targetFilterFunction: // Parameter (on a Service Proxy Operation) return ["f11273c1-217f-4f42-b690-3d8b488f95a8"].indexOf(element.specializationId) >= 0;

property.hint: The default as written in the code, e.g. 1, "en" or null. Formatted like a service operation parameter's Value: a string is quoted unless it already is, or is null, default or an expression; an enum literal is qualified with its enum type; a value starting with @ is used verbatim without the @. The CancellationToken parameter's default is set by Async Configuration instead.
property.name: Value
